text:
lauren-partnerships: Quick sync — Datadog asked to keep the announcement embargoed until Tue 03/12 EOD. We need the GPU trace + dashboard demo ready and a short recorded walkthrough for partner press. Who can take the dash updates?

mike-obs: I can update panels. Noted the big item is the GPU trace sampling rate — current panel shows token-level spikes that confuse the demo. Need to smooth sampling and add a per-model legend.

sumi-datadog: thanks both. On our side we'll prep a partner quote and a small banner for the marketplace tile. Embargo is firm on our end. Also can host the recorded demo on our private S3 if you want.

ashley-marketing: FYI we need a 60s clip + 30s cut for socials. Can we get the recording by Mon 03/11? Otherwise we won't have time for review. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

kyler-pm: Timeline check — Mike, is Mon feasible for recording if we get final dashboard by Sun morning?

mike-obs: Maybe. If I can get a reproducible run that includes the OTLP trace enriched with model metadata, I can polish panels Sat night. Need Kyler to confirm which models to show (redwood/model-x v2 or v2-quant).

kyler-pm: Let's show v2 on hosted + v2-quant on Dedicated — gives a nice contrast in trace durations. Also capture a fallback event (model routed to cost-tier fallback) if possible.

lauren-partnerships: Good call. Sumi — can Datadog provide a short snippet to ingest our OTLP trace fields so the dashboard labels map to "model_version" and "customer_tier"?

sumi-datadog: Yep, we'll share a collector snippet. Example config (drop into your otel-collector config):

```yaml
receivers:
  otlp:
    protocols:
      grpc:
      http:
processors:
  batch:
  attributes:
    actions:
      - key: model.version
        action: insert
        value: "+{{resource.attributes.model.version}}"
exporters:
  datadog:
    api_key: "<DD_API_KEY>"
service:
  pipelines:
    traces:
      receivers: [otlp]
      processors: [batch, attributes]
      exporters: [datadog]
```

mike-obs: That attributes action looks useful — will adapt to our resource keys. Also adding a small derived metric: avg_token_latency_per_model. That should flatten the spikes for the demo.

legal-bot: Reminder: any partner quote must be signed off. @lauren-partnerships please route the quote through legal review. We need a signed partner release before publishing.

lauren-partnerships: On it — I'll draft the quote and send to legal by EOD today.

ashley-marketing: Also need final marketplace tile assets (logo + 1-liner + 2 screenshots) by Mon noon. Sumi, can Datadog share a white background png of the Datadog tile?

sumi-datadog: Sharing assets now — uploading to the partnership drive: <https://drive.datadog.partners/redwood-obs-assets>. Use the 900x600 screenshot for marketplace.

mike-obs: Quick note — the dashboard has two demo-only widgets (synthetic load and fallback marker). I'll keep them in an "_demo" folder and we can strip before publishing if legal wants.

kyler-pm: Can someone create a one-line runbook for the demo so the partner engineer can hit play and not worry about env vars? Something like: `./demo/run.sh --models v2,v2-quant --token-count 1024`

deploy-bot: deploy job started: infra/testing-demo-env #4432. ETA ~12m. CI artifacts: <https://ci.redwood/integrations/4432/artifacts>

lauren-partnerships: Great — action items: Mike update dashboard + add demo runbook (due Sun 03/10 11:59pm), Kyler confirm trace scenarios (done), Ashley prepare social cuts after recording, Sumi share collector snippet & assets (done), Legal to sign quote (in flight). If anyone hits a blocker ping here and I'll escalate to partner PM. :thumbsup:

mike-obs: I'll post the dashboard JSON and a short screen recording link in this thread once CI finishes.

ashley-marketing: Perfect, thanks all.

lauren-partnerships: Closing loop — embargo reminder: do not post anything public until we have legal sign-off + Datadog confirms go-live.

mike-obs: ack.
